description: Build the signed-in user's OWN data model: create nodes, link them to standard elements by stableId, link the user's nodes to each other, set properties on the user's nodes, and delete the user's nodes. Every write is additive and isolated to the user's workspace; golden standard nodes can never be modified or deleted. Nodes are auto-tagged :UserContent; the user layer is text-only (no embeddings), and every link the user makes is stamped as theirs (userAuthored, userRefId, userEdgeRefId, authoredAt).
_note: No startup needed. POSTs over HTTP to the educore executor (/api/dme-user-graph-write) using server-internal auth from env (DME_API_BASE, DME_INTERNAL_SECRET, DME_VERSION_REF_ID). User mode only. All invariants enforced server-side.

definition.name: dme_user_create_node
definition.description: Create a new node in the user's graph. It is automatically tagged :UserContent, and given a stable userNodeId. The user layer is text-only: no embedding is made. Returns the new userNodeId — keep it to link or edit the node later.

definition.name: dme_user_connect_to_standard
definition.description: Link one of the user's nodes to a STANDARD element by the element's stableId. Find the stableId first with a dme_user_query (e.g. MATCH (n:ForgedNode) WHERE n.role IN ['DmeClass','DmeProperty','DmeOptionSet','DmeOptionValue'] AND toLower(n.name) CONTAINS 'birth' RETURN n.name, n._source, n.stableId LIMIT 25). Any standard in the build can be linked. The target must be a :ForgedNode in a declared element role (class, property, option set, option value); anything else returns a clear error. EXACT_MATCH, CLOSE_MATCH, BROAD_MATCH and NARROW_MATCH are the judge's relations and are refused: use your own, e.g. ALIGNS_WITH.

userNodeId.description: The userNodeId of the user's node (the source of the relationship)

relType.description: Relationship type, e.g. ALIGNS_WITH or MAPS_TO (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE); the four match relation types are refused

standardStableId.description: The stableId of the standard element to link to

definition.name: dme_user_connect_nodes
definition.description: Create a relationship between two of the user's OWN nodes (both identified by userNodeId).

relType.description: Relationship type (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE); the four match relation types are refused

definition.name: dme_user_set_property
definition.description: Set a single property on one of the user's OWN nodes (by userNodeId). Golden standard nodes cannot be modified — that is refused server-side.

userNodeId.description: userNodeId of the user's node to modify

definition.name: dme_user_delete_node
definition.description: Delete one of the user's OWN nodes (by userNodeId) and its relationships. Golden standard nodes cannot be deleted — that is refused server-side.

userNodeId.description: userNodeId of the user's node to delete
